title: STAR: Improving Lifetime and Performance of High-Capacity Modern SSDs Using State-Aware Randomizer
problem: Lateral charge spreading (LCS) in high-capacity 3D NAND flash causes retention errors that significantly reduce SSD lifetime, particularly as stack heights increase.
motivation: Enable higher-capacity SSDs by mitigating LCS-induced reliability challenges without substantial performance overhead.
method: STAR: state-aware data randomizer that proactively eliminates weak data patterns vulnerable to LCS. Uses dual-polarity read for error detection and adaptive error-aware read with analytical Vth drift estimation for correction.
key_novelty: First data randomizer specifically targeting LCS-induced weak patterns in high-capacity 3D NAND SSDs.
contributions: Error rates below 10^-13 without significant overhead
Efficient integration into existing SSD controller I/O datapath
limitations: Evaluated on real-world traces from 160 3D NAND chips; specific to 3D NAND SSDs.
primary_theme: State-aware randomization to mitigate lateral charge spreading in 3D NAND
